name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended in front of you and your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and squat down as deep as you can on the standing leg, keeping the other leg off the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Hold a support or squat to a box if needed, and complete reps before switching legs.
image_prompt_scene: Standing on one leg with the other leg extended forward and the arms forward.
